text.tspan: Defender for Storage scans the new blob asynchronously and writes the result as a blob index tag
p95 target under 1.5 s on office Wi-Fi
The claimant is told about the decision through the same outbox, queue and dispatcher path

svg.text: Start new claim (category, date, amount LKR, description)
INSERT claim status=Draft, approverId + audit row (none to Draft) in one transaction
Attach receipt image(s), up to 5 files of 10 MB each
Check count and size limits and allowed type (JPEG or PNG)
200 OK upload URL (user-delegation SAS, this blob only, 15 min)
BEGIN, UPDATE status=Submitted, INSERT audit row, INSERT outbox claim.submitted, COMMIT
Outbox Publisher picks up the unsent event
POST Adaptive Card payload to webhook URL
Flow bot chat card with "Review claim" deep link
Access policy check (caller is the claim's approver)
200 OK claim + read-only receipt URLs (SAS, 5 min)
GET blob index tags (malware scan result)
UPDATE status=Approved + audit row + outbox claim.decided in one transaction
UPDATE status=Rejected + audit row with reason + outbox claim.decided
Tap "Request info" and enter a question
UPDATE status=Draft + audit row with question + outbox claim.info_requested
